flashcard_questions.q: Which Free City did Hitler demand Germany get back in 1939?

flashcard_questions.a: A strip of land giving Poland access to the Baltic Sea.

flashcard_questions.q: Which German territory did the Polish Corridor cut off?
What was the Gleiwitz Incident of 31 August 1939?
flashcard_questions.a: A staged attack by SS men dressed as Polish soldiers.

flashcard_questions.q: Why did the SS leave a body in a Polish uniform at Gleiwitz?
flashcard_questions.a: To make the fake attack look real.

flashcard_questions.q: On what date did Germany invade Poland?

What name was given to the German tanks that smashed Polish defences?
Which German aircraft destroyed Polish communications and supply lines?
Why was the Polish army no match for German armour?
flashcard_questions.a: It still used horse-mounted cavalry against tanks and aircraft.

flashcard_questions.q: Britain and France declared war on Germany on ____.
At what time did Chamberlain tell the nation Britain was at war?
What did the Soviet Red Army do on 17 September 1939?
flashcard_questions.a: It invaded Poland from the east.
